01A customer for whom we prepared the building permit design documentation in the summer for…

A customer for whom we prepared the building permit design documentation in the summer for a BC 4 BASIC domestic wastewater treatment plant (WWTP) got in touch to say it was time to install the WWTP, as the permit had now arrived.

The customer is building a new single-family house in Smilkov and is doing most of the work himself, for which he has our admiration. He also did the excavation and preparatory work himself, so all that was left for us was to commission the system.

Downstream of the BC 4 BASIC WWTP there is a self-supporting plastic storage tank with a volume of 2.0 m3, which stores the treated wastewater. During the growing season (April–September) water from the tank will be used to water the greenery. Outside the growing season, the treated wastewater will be discharged into an underground soakaway on the client's plot, which was already in place at the time of installation.

02Because the sewer pipe is laid deeper than usual, the WWTP and the storage tank were fitted with a plastic extension…

Because the sewer pipe is laid deeper than usual, the WWTP and the storage tank were fitted with a plastic extension 800 mm high.

The client placed the technical equipment (the blower and the BASIC control unit) in the utility room of the house.
